objective: Run a non-US, GSC-qualified faculty/course-owner backlink pilot with individual preflights and without lowering the 7/10 hard gates.

decision.reason: Four opportunities passed their individual registry, Gmail, referring-domain, exact-page GSC, donor/target and official-route preflights and were Sent-verified without an immediate bounce. A fifth institution was not resent because the preflight found verified prior outreach to the exact course channel on 2026-08-18. Two opportunities remain conditional future rechecks and six fail an exact hard or policy gate.

gsc_contract.note: Only exact-page rows materialized in the dated local GSC artifact were used. Where no row materialized, the report states: no materialized exact-page GSC evidence; score 0 by contract. This is not evidence of zero impressions.

registry.collision_policy: Root-domain history, the one-institution/90-day rule, same-target open-contact counts and opportunity-key collisions were checked before each send.

gmail.coverage: Sent, Drafts and Scheduled collision checks; four Sent verifications; immediate bounce checks; historical collision verification
gmail.retained_data: Counts, dates and non-sensitive states only

semrush.live_api_limitation: The connected Semrush API reported insufficient units; no missing metric was estimated.

public_web.coverage: HTTP response, English content, current ownership, canonical/indexability signals, contextual href/rel precedent, target sitemap/public access and official route
public_web.conditional_rechecks: Manchester still requires live access plus exact-page GSC evidence; Lund requires fresh exact-page GSC evidence.

historical_academic_baseline.interpretation: The pre-pilot history is US-heavy. The Austrian live result supports testing a broader geography, but does not prove that the academic link caused any ranking change. The four new contacts on 2026-08-25 are tracked separately as pilot actions.

monitoring.pause_rule: After five sends, pause if the bounce rate exceeds 20 percent.
monitoring.measurement_rule: If a contextual live link appears, freeze title, H1, canonical and main internal-link structure for 56 days and evaluate GSC at T0, T+14, T+35, T+56, with permanence at T+84.
